title: Cellectar to Restate Previously Issued Financial Statements – Company Announces Receipt of Expected Delinquency Notification Letter from Nasdaq
description: Cellectar Biosciences, Inc. announced that it needs to restate its previously issued financial statements due to a review of its accounting treatment for warrants issued in a 2022 financing. The company has received a delinquency notification from Nasdaq and has 60 days to submit a plan to regain compliance.

title: Cellectar Biosciences Announces Compliance Regarding Filing of Form 10-Q
description: Cellectar Biosciences, Inc. announced that it has regained compliance with Nasdaq Listing Rule 5250(c)(1) after filing restated financial statements for 2022, 2023, and the first half of 2024.
